newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to test 128.90 prop then climb.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to test 128.90 prop then climb.

text.p: September Notionnel futures traded on MATIF have the potential to move higher eventually but may first move down on Tuesday towards key support around 128.90, technical analysts said.

"The notionnel hasn't started positively. It has come off since the opening and will probably test critical support around the 128.90 area," said Adrian Sells, director of Crane Investment Analysis in London.
But he said the underlying market looked good and a break out and close above the 129.50 area would continue the upside potential.
Sells said in the short term some preliminary support was offered at 129.02.
At 0805 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 129.08, down 14 basis points on the day.
"For today notionnel might well be capped by the opening but if we get above 129.24 then we'll get a challenge set up towards 129.50," Sells said.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London also saw the overall picture for the contract as constructive.
"So far (notionnel) has kept above 129.00. More important is 128.40 which it must hold to avoid a drop in momentum," they said in a research note.
At the short end, September Pibor was at 96.54, down 0.01 on the day.
The European bank analysts said a break below 96.50 would negate the recent bullish break, but while the picture stayed constructive there were good prospects for putting 96.65 under pressure.
